W6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Seven intervals is seven points. W3 and W5 test a monotone relationship on a sample
that small, and one interval moving rank can shift the coefficient by 0.2 or more.
Beating persistence on a per-interval change says nothing about whether the change
predicted is biologically correct: replicate 4 is one measurement, not the truth.
RUV's controls are the lowest-|plateau| fifth of the roster, so if the contaminating
component lives in responders rather than quiet genes, RUV cannot see it and a FAIL
here would not mean the component is absent.
